title: Signal and Orbit
author: Ada Pemberton
blurb: Marguerite Sandoval, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
